_template_notes: Elseworlds / What-If fanfic — the primary AU mode. Franchise terminology is preserved; canon_expert enforces internal consistency of the AU's own canon, not the source franchise. Drift from the source is declared via universe_meta.branch_point. Edit <EDIT_ME> placeholders with the source franchise's continuity tier, era, and the specific cross-continuity violations that would break this AU's voice.
